notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42349346/71f637d0c21c3dd113e18fcdf8a19c6ad6ad1841.png[/img]

0.1.121

1. Added animation to fix the angle of the coin and improve visibility.

2. Adjusted the color of the speech bubble.

3. Item effects have been added to the equipment sold in the store.

4. Mimic's lines have been added.

5. Lowered the rate at which bombs appear from stone chests.

6. Renamed some settings in Graphics Options.

7. Added UI size adjustment function to graphic settings.

8. Changed so that some UIs can be closed by pressing the ESC menu button.
